adversarial.why:
My mandate is the strongest honest DENY case and to default toward deny when the opportunity is merely passable; on that standard my call is YES-DENY (override the 3c BUY into a DO NOT BUY). But honesty requires flagging this as genuinely BORDERLINE, not a slam-dunk, because the deny does NOT clear on the firewall or the spine — it clears only on the sharpened RKLB opportunity bar.

The deny case: SENS falls short of RKLB-2024 on the three dimensions that define a *great* setup. (a) INFLECTION is not present in the RKLB sense — only the mechanical Ascensia-rev-share margin leg is shown; backlog/firm-cash are absent, OCF is moving the wrong way (burn doubled YoY), and the load-bearing AID growth leg is asserted-not-shown, with the absences landing exactly where the thesis needs them (the dossier's own round-tripper tell). RKLB had multiple discriminators live simultaneously; SENS has zero cleanly present. (b) The re-rate CATALYST is undated — the company has not timelined the AID units disclosure that drives it; only base/dead-money prints land soon (P(>=2x@12mo)=0.22). (c) The RKLB-grade REWARD (>=4x) is a 12%-prob tail resting on the unshown legs, while the base case is ~2x against an active dilution headwind (live $300M shelf/$100M ATM, $5.00 strike cap, authorized shares doubled). A ~2x base + undated re-rate + 12%-prob >=4x tail is the textbook "passable, better as cash" profile. The book is empty, so there is literally no quota pressure forcing a buy — the cleanest possible hold-cash condition, and selectivity IS the quality bar.

Why it is borderline rather than a clear deny: four real counterweights, each conceded honestly. (1) RISK passes — ~25-30% impairment, survival clears >6 quarters, going-concern alleviated, debt 2029; this is survivable, NOT ruin, so the firewall does NOT fire and the deny cannot lean on §9. (2) The THEME is genuinely early/strong/macro-backed (real ~$15B/~15%-CAGR already-monetized market, HUNT P3, recognition open) — the one dimension SENS arguably matches RKLB on. (3) The shown legs are REAL and de-risking, not vapor — a durable 59% GAAP GM across two quarters, +87% revenue accel, and the new ADA one-year 93% wear-time durability data that directly validates the core differentiation. (4) The geometry is a respectable asymmetry — ~3.7:1 blended U/D, a financing floor only ~24% below the live, not-extended entry, prob-weighted ~+68%. A defensible reviewer could rationally HOLD the existing BUY on those grounds.

Net: I land on yes-deny because the bar is explicitly RKLB-*great*, not 3c-clean, and SENS is short on inflection-presence, catalyst-dating, and RKLB-grade reward — three of the five dimensions — with the >=4x quarantined to a low-odds tail on the asserted leg. But the honest characterization of the decision is BORDERLINE: this is a sound, survivable great_trade declined for being merely passable against a deliberately high bar, not a name that fails the spine or trips the firewall. If the AID leg ever discloses units (the missing inflection) or the company dates that disclosure (the missing catalyst), it re-enters via a later scan as a materially stronger candidate.
